info.title: HR Website API
info.description: API documentation for the HR Website backend.

role.description: Vai trò hệ thống; OWNER/CHU mới quản lý được nhân sự.

is_active.description: false nghĩa là tài khoản đã nghỉ việc.

organization.description: null khi tài khoản chưa tạo và chưa tham gia tổ chức nào (màn hình /onboarding).

code.description: Mã tham gia của tổ chức; null khi người gọi không phải OWNER/CHU (RLS giữ mã lại).

member_count.description: Số tài khoản trong tổ chức (chỉ đếm được người cùng tổ chức).

pending_invite_count.description: Số lời mời chưa được sử dụng (claimed_by còn null).

role.description: Vai trò khi gia nhập; lời mời không bao giờ tạo ra OWNER.

source.description: provisioned = chủ sở hữu tạo tài khoản với mật khẩu tạm (SCRUM-52), invite = mời tài khoản đã có.

must_change_password.description: Luôn true: tài khoản phải tự đổi mật khẩu tạm ở /change-password trước khi dùng hệ thống.

emailConfirmationRequired.description: true khi dự án Supabase bật xác nhận email: tài khoản đã tạo nhưng chưa có phiên đăng nhập.

attendance_radius.description: Bán kính cho phép chấm công (mét) quanh toạ độ chi nhánh.

request_type.description: Loại đơn: nghỉ phép, đổi ca, điều chỉnh công, ...

approver_id.description: Người duyệt (lấy từ phiên đăng nhập).

requester.description: Nhân viên nhúng từ khoá ngoại requests_user_id_fkey; null khi RLS ẩn hồ sơ.

name.description: Tên ca làm việc (Ca sáng, Ca chiều, Nghỉ, ...).

branch_id.description: null nghĩa là ca áp dụng cho mọi chi nhánh.

status.description: Đi làm, nghỉ phép hoặc đã huỷ.

employee.description: Nhân viên nhúng từ khoá ngoại; null khi RLS ẩn hồ sơ.

shift.description: Ca làm việc nhúng từ khoá ngoại (kèm giờ để kiểm tra trùng ca).

work_date.description: Ngày nghiệp vụ (Asia/Bangkok) mà bản ghi trạng thái mô tả.

role.description: Vai trò hệ thống: OWNER, CHU hoặc EMPLOYEE.

status.description: Đang làm việc, chưa vào ca, nghỉ phép, đã tan ca, không có ca hôm nay, đã nghỉ việc.

attendance_radius.description: Bán kính cho phép của chi nhánh, để so với khoảng cách chấm công.

shift_id.description: Ca đã xếp; null khi làm ngoài lịch.

check_in_distance_m.description: Khoảng cách (mét) từ điểm chấm công tới tâm chi nhánh, dùng để xét vùng hợp lệ. Database tính lại từ toạ độ nên không do client gửi.

complaint_status.description: null khi chưa có khiếu nại; OPEN từ lúc ghi nhận tới khi quản lý xử lý xong.

verified_by.description: Quản lý đã xác minh bản ghi.

corrected_by.description: Quản lý đã sửa giờ của bản ghi (SCRUM-23).

correction_reason.description: Lý do sửa giờ, bắt buộc khi có corrected_at.

branch.description: Chi nhánh nhúng kèm toạ độ và bán kính để xét vùng chấm công.

question.description: Câu hỏi của nhân viên về chính sách, quy định hoặc hợp đồng.
question.example: Chính sách nghỉ phép năm của công ty là bao nhiêu ngày?

content.description: Nội dung đoạn tài liệu được tìm thấy.

source.description: Tên / tiêu đề tài liệu nguồn (dùng để trích dẫn).

similarity.description: Điểm tương đồng cosine với câu hỏi [0, 1].

answer.description: Câu trả lời được sinh bởi Gemini dựa trên ngữ cảnh tài liệu.
answer.example: Theo [Nguồn 1: Nội quy công ty], nhân viên được nghỉ phép 12 ngày mỗi năm.

sources.description: Danh sách các đoạn tài liệu được dùng làm ngữ cảnh, sắp xếp theo độ tương đồng giảm dần.

branch_id.description: Chi nhánh sở hữu thiết bị (public.branches.id).

code.description: Mã tài sản / số serial trên tem thiết bị.

category.description: Nhóm thiết bị (Khu pha chế, Bảo quản lạnh, ...).

quantity.description: Số lượng thiết bị cùng loại tại chi nhánh.

condition.description: Tình trạng: tốt, cần theo dõi, đang sửa chữa, hỏng (SCRUM-46 xử lý bảo trì).

error.example: Trường `question` là bắt buộc và phải là chuỗi không rỗng.

get.summary: Look up a user, or list the staff directory
get.description:
With `?id=<uuid>` returns that profile (id, full name, role). Without `id` returns the
whole staff directory (SCRUM-24) including `is_active`, which only an OWNER/CHU may read.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The user's UUID. Omit it to list the staff directory.

200.description: The requested user, or the staff directory.

400.description: The id query parameter is not a UUID.

403.description: The caller has no user profile, or is not allowed to read the directory.

404.description: No user exists with the supplied ID.

patch.summary: Change a staff member's role or employment state
patch.description:
SCRUM-24: gives an account a different role (`OWNER`, `CHU`, `EMPLOYEE`) or marks it as
left/returned (`is_active`). Restricted to OWNER/CHU, only an OWNER may grant or revoke
the OWNER role, and nobody may change their own role or deactivate themselves.

is_active.description: false means the account has left the company.

400.description: The id is not a UUID, the body is invalid, or the change would lock the caller out.

403.description: The caller has no profile, is not a manager, or tried to touch the OWNER role.

404.description: The account does not exist or is not updatable by the caller.

get.description:
Returns the shift catalogue ("Ca sáng" 08:00–17:00, "Ca chiều", ...) that
`/api/schedules` assigns to employees. `branch_id = null` means the template applies to
every branch. SCRUM-30.

This endpoint used to serve the in-memory mock shift list; the schedule itself now lives
in `public.shift_assignments` behind `/api/schedules`.
Searches only data accessible to the authenticated user under the active Supabase RLS policies.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Limits the result to one resource type.

400.description: The search query or type is invalid.

403.description: The authenticated account has no eligible user profile.

get.description:
The week/day view of the schedule (SCRUM-30). Each row is one employee assigned to one
shift template on one business date, with the employee name and the shift hours
embedded so the screen needs a single request.

200.description: The shift assignments, ordered by date.

400.description: A filter is not a UUID or not a calendar date.

post.description:
Assigns one employee to one shift template on one business date. Answers `409` when the
same employee already has an overlapping shift that day (or the exact same template).
Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts by RLS.

400.description: The request body is invalid.

404.description: The referenced shift template does not exist.

409.description: The employee already has an overlapping shift on that date.

put.description: Replaces the employee, branch, template, date, status and note of one assignment. Answers 409 on an overlap and 404 for an unknown or non-updatable row. SCRUM-30.

400.description: The id is not a UUID, or the request body is invalid.

404.description: The assignment or the referenced shift template was not found.

409.description: The employee already has an overlapping shift on that date.

delete.description: Removes one assignment from the schedule. Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts by RLS. SCRUM-30.

400.description: The id is not a UUID.

404.description: The assignment does not exist or is not deletable by the caller.

get.description: Reports closed-shift revenue (close_amount minus open_amount) in the Asia/Bangkok business timezone and compares it with the preceding equivalent period.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: Limits the report to one branch. Omit for all accessible branches.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: A date within the requested business period; defaults to today in Asia/Bangkok.

200.description: The aggregated report and period-over-period comparison.

400.description: One or more query parameters are invalid.

post.summary: Declare opening revenue for a branch
post.description: Creates one opening-revenue declaration per branch for the current business day (Asia/Bangkok).

400.description: The request body is invalid.

409.description: Opening revenue was already declared for this branch today.

put.summary: Declare closing revenue for a branch
put.description: Closes the current business day's opening-revenue record for a branch (Asia/Bangkok).

close_note.example: Cash counted and reconciled at shift end.

revenue_difference.description: close_amount minus open_amount; UI can use this for warnings.

400.description: The request body is invalid.

404.description: No opening-revenue declaration exists for this branch today.

get.description:
The approval queue of SCRUM-41: leave, shift-swap and adjustment requests with the
requester name embedded from `requests.user_id`. The value `all` disables a filter, which
is what the dashboard pills send.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact status to filter by; "all" disables this filter.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: Branch UUID to filter by; "all" disables this filter.

200.description: Requests matching the optional filters, most recently updated first.

400.description: branch_id is neither a UUID nor "all".

patch.description:
Sets `requests.status` together with `reject_reason` and `approver_id`. Restricted to
OWNER/CHU accounts: the use case checks the caller's role and the
`requests_update_managers` RLS policy (SCRUM-41) repeats the check in the database.

reject_reason.description: Required and non-empty when status is REJECTED.

400.description: The id is not a UUID, the body is invalid, or a rejection has no reason.

403.description: The caller has no user profile, or the role may not review requests.

404.description: The request does not exist or is not reviewable by the caller.

post.description:
SCRUM-51: creates the organization of the signed-in account and makes the caller its OWNER.
Registering no longer grants any role — ownership comes from creating an organization here.
The organization receives the join code that colleagues spend (together with an invite on
file) to join it.

201.description: The organization was created and the caller is its OWNER.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or the name is shorter than 2 or longer than 120 characters.

403.description: The account has no user profile.

409.description: The account already belongs to an organization.

post.summary: Join an organization with its code
post.description:
SCRUM-51: joins the caller's account to the organization that owns the code. Two things
must be true, and the database checks both: the code must match `organization_join_codes`,
and the caller's email must be on that organization's register (`organization_invites`) and
unclaimed. An outsider who obtains the code therefore gets `403` — this is the point of the
invite list. Ten failed attempts per hour are refused with `429`. A `CHU` invite grants the
manager role; an invite can never mint an OWNER.

200.description: Joined. Answers the same summary as `/api/organizations/current`.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or the code is not a plausible code.

403.description: No profile, a wrong code, or an account that organization did not register.

409.description: The account already belongs to an organization.

429.description: Too many failed attempts in the last hour.

get.description:
SCRUM-51: the register of accounts the organization knows — both `invite` rows (an owner
asked an existing account to join) and `provisioned` rows (an owner created the account and
handed over a temporary password, SCRUM-52). `claimed_at` says whether the person has
joined. OWNER/CHU only; RLS hides other organizations' rows.

403.description: The account has no profile, or the role may not manage invites.

404.description: The caller does not belong to an organization.

post.summary: Invite an existing account to the organization
post.description:
SCRUM-51: puts an email on the organization's register. The person keeps their own password
(this is the path for somebody who already signed up); the invite is what makes the join
code usable for them, and `role` is capped at `CHU` — an invite never mints an OWNER.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, the email is malformed, or the role/full name failed validation.

403.description: The account has no profile, or the role may not manage invites.

404.description: The caller does not belong to an organization.

409.description: That email is already on the organization's list.

delete.description:
SCRUM-51: withdraws an invite that has not been claimed, so that address can no longer
spend the join code. Removing somebody who already joined is a staff action instead
(`is_active = false` on `/staff`). OWNER/CHU only; another organization's invite is a `404`.

400.description: The id is not a UUID.

403.description: The account has no profile, or the role may not manage invites.

404.description: The invite does not exist or belongs to another organization.

get.description:
SCRUM-51: the organization of the signed-in account plus its member and pending-invite
counts. `organization` is null while the caller has not created or joined one, which is
what the onboarding gate uses. `code` is null unless the caller is OWNER/CHU — the join
code is hidden by RLS, not by a check here.

200.description: The organization summary (organization may be null).

403.description: The account has no user profile.

patch.summary: Rename the organization or rotate its join code
patch.description:
SCRUM-51: `name` renames the organization (OWNER/CHU) and `rotate_code: true` replaces the
join code (OWNER only) — the old code stops working immediately, which is how an owner cuts
off a code that leaked without touching the invites of the people they meant to add.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, nothing was asked for, or the name failed validation.

403.description: The account has no profile, is not a manager, or is not the OWNER for a rotation.

404.description: The caller does not belong to an organization.

get.summary: Is the staff account service available?
get.description:
SCRUM-52: probes the `staff-account` Edge Function with the caller's own token and reports
*why* it is unusable, not merely that it is. `reason` separates "not deployed" (an operator
task) from "not allowed" (this account is not OWNER/CHU of an organization), "unauthenticated"
(the function refused the session token) and "misconfigured" (deployed but answering 5xx, for
example missing secrets). The Tổ chức screen offers the provisioning form only for `ready`.

200.description: Whether the function answered, and the reason.

detail.description: Short message from the function (or the transport failure); safe for a manager to read.

403.description: The account has no user profile.

post.summary: Create a staff account with a temporary password
post.description:
SCRUM-52: asks the `staff-account` Edge Function — the only holder of the service-role key —
to create a real Supabase Auth account for a colleague, with the temporary password the
owner typed. The account is added to the organization's register (`source = provisioned`)
and must change that password on first sign-in; it then joins with the organization code
like any other invited account. OWNER/CHU of the organization only.

password.description: Mật khẩu tạm; hệ thống không lưu lại, chủ sở hữu tự trao cho nhân viên.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or a field failed validation.

403.description: No profile, no organization, or a role that may not manage accounts.

409.description: The email already has an account or already belongs to the organization.

429.description: Too many accounts were created for this organization in the last hour.

503.description: The staff account Edge Function is not deployed (or not reachable).

post.summary: Give a member a new temporary password
post.description:
SCRUM-52: for the case where the owner no longer has the temporary password they handed
over. Only accounts inside the caller's own organization are accepted (the Edge Function
checks this with the service client); the member must choose a new password on next
sign-in.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or a field failed validation.

403.description: No profile, no organization, a role that may not manage accounts, or another organization's member.

429.description: Too many attempts for this organization in the last hour.

503.description: The staff account Edge Function is not deployed (or not reachable).

get.summary: Get notifications for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns a paginated list of notifications for the current user, sorted newest first.

patch.description: Sets is_read to true for the specified notification owned by the authenticated user.

400.description: The ID is not a valid UUID.

404.description: The notification was not found or does not belong to the user.

get.summary: Get notification settings for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns the notification channel preferences for the current user.

put.summary: Update notification settings for the authenticated user
put.description: Creates or updates notification channel preferences. Uses upsert on (user_id, channel).

400.description: The request body is invalid.

get.description: Returns the per-branch facilities visible to the authenticated caller under the active RLS policy, sorted by name. SCRUM-45.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: Restrict the list to one branch.

400.description: branch_id is not a UUID.

post.description: Registers one facility of a branch. Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts by RLS.

400.description: The request body is invalid.

put.description: Replaces the editable fields of one facility. Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts by RLS; a hidden or unknown id answers 404. SCRUM-45.

400.description: The id is not a UUID, or the request body is invalid.

404.description: The facility does not exist or is not updatable by the caller.

delete.description: Removes one facility from the registry. Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts by RLS. SCRUM-45.

400.description: The id is not a UUID.

404.description: The facility does not exist or is not deletable by the caller.

get.summary: Get the live employee status of one business day
get.description:
One row per person for the day (SCRUM-22), derived from `shift_assignments` and
`attendance` by the `get_employee_status` RPC: đang làm việc, chưa vào ca, nghỉ phép,
đã tan ca, không có ca hôm nay or nghỉ việc. The day defaults to today in Asia/Bangkok.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: Only the people scheduled to, or checking in at, this branch.

parameters.name: work_date
parameters.description: Business day to report (defaults to today in Asia/Bangkok).

200.description: The snapshot and the day it describes.

400.description: branch_id is not a UUID, or work_date is not a calendar date.

post.summary: Hỏi đáp chính sách, quy định và hợp đồng bằng AI
post.description:
Nhận câu hỏi từ người dùng, tạo embedding bằng Gemini `text-embedding-004`,
tìm kiếm các đoạn tài liệu liên quan qua Supabase vector search
(`match_company_documents` và `match_user_contracts`), sau đó gọi
`gemini-1.5-flash` để sinh câu trả lời có trích dẫn nguồn.

**Quy tắc trả lời của AI:**
- Chỉ trả lời dựa trên nội dung tài liệu nội bộ tìm được.
- Trích dẫn rõ nguồn tài liệu trong câu trả lời.
- Nếu không có thông tin, trả lời: *"Tôi không có thông tin về vấn đề này. Vui lòng liên hệ quản lý để được hỗ trợ."*

200.description: Câu trả lời được sinh bởi AI kèm danh sách nguồn tài liệu.

400.description: Thiếu hoặc sai định dạng trường `question`.

401.description: Người dùng chưa đăng nhập hoặc session hết hạn.

500.description: Lỗi máy chủ nội bộ (Supabase RPC hoặc Gemini API).

get.description: Returns every branch visible to the authenticated caller under the active RLS policy, sorted by name.

post.description: Creates a branch together with its GPS geofence. Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts by RLS.

name.example: Chi nhánh Quận 1 - Flagship Bến Thành

address.example: 128 Lê Lợi, Phường Bến Thành, Quận 1, TP. Hồ Chí Minh

attendance_radius.description: Allowed check-in distance in metres (defaults to 50).

400.description: The request body is invalid.

put.description: Replaces the editable fields of one branch (name, address, manager, GPS geofence). Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts by RLS.

attendance_radius.description: Allowed check-in distance in metres. Keeps the current value when omitted.

400.description: The route parameter or request body is invalid.

404.description: No branch exists with the supplied ID, or the caller may not update it.

post.description: Creates a Supabase Auth account and, through the SCRUM-50 `on_auth_user_created` trigger, the matching `public.users` profile with the default role `EMPLOYEE`. When the Supabase project requires email confirmation, no session is created and the response says so.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or email/password/full_name failed validation.

409.description: An account already exists for this email address.

post.description: Clears the Supabase Auth session cookies. Safe to call without an active session.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Exchanges email/password credentials for a Supabase Auth session and writes the session cookies onto the response.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or email/password is missing.

401.description: The email or password is incorrect.

get.description: Returns the `users` profile (full name and role) of the account behind the current Supabase Auth session, so the shell can label the header without a client-side join.

200.description: The profile of the signed-in account.

404.description: The account has no row in the users table.

post.description:
SCRUM-52: replaces the caller's password through Supabase Auth with their own session (no
service role) and clears the `must_change_password` flag that `proxy.ts` reads. This is how
an account an owner created with a temporary password becomes a normal account.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or the password is shorter than 8 characters.

get.description:
The Bảng công timesheet (SCRUM-21/22/29). Each row embeds the employee name, the branch
(with its GPS centre and allowed radius, so the screen can judge the geofence) and the
shift hours. Check-in and check-out themselves happen in the mobile app.

200.description: The attendance records, most recent work date first.

400.description: A filter is not a UUID, not a calendar date, or not a known status.

patch.description:
Fixes the times, status and note of one record (SCRUM-23) and stamps `corrected_by`,
`corrected_at` and `correction_reason`, so a manager can repair a wrong timesheet that
payroll would otherwise trust. Restricted to OWNER/CHU: the use case checks the role and
the `attendance_update_managers` RLS policy repeats it in the database. The reason is
mandatory.

correction_reason.example: Máy chấm công lỗi, nhân viên có báo trước khi vào ca.

400.description: The id is not a UUID, the body is invalid, the reason is missing, or giờ ra precedes giờ vào.

403.description: The caller has no user profile, or the role may not correct records.

404.description: The record does not exist or is not correctable by the caller.

patch.description:
Stamps `verified_by` and `verified_at` on one record: this is the web review action of
SCRUM-22 (toạ độ + ảnh xác minh + trạng thái hợp lệ). Restricted to OWNER/CHU accounts,
and the `attendance_update_managers` RLS policy repeats the check in the database.

400.description: The id is not a UUID.

403.description: The caller has no user profile, or the role may not verify records.

404.description: The record does not exist or is not verifiable by the caller.

post.summary: Record a complaint against an attendance record
post.description:
Stores the employee's khiếu nại (SCRUM-29) with the current timestamp. The employee on
the record may raise it themselves, and an OWNER/CHU manager may raise it for them (the
complaint usually arrives by phone); anyone else is refused with `403`.

complaint.example: Máy chấm công không nhận diện được khuôn mặt nên em vào ca muộn 10 phút.

201.description: The attendance record with the complaint stored.

400.description: The JSON body is invalid, or the complaint is empty or too long.

403.description: The caller is neither the employee on the record nor an OWNER/CHU manager.

404.description: The attendance record does not exist.

patch.summary: Resolve a complaint on an attendance record
patch.description:
Closes an open khiếu nại (SCRUM-23): sets `complaint_status` to `RESOLVED` and stamps
`complaint_resolved_by` / `complaint_resolved_at`. Only OWNER/CHU may resolve one, while
the employee on the record may raise it (POST /api/attendance/complaints).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The attendance record id that carries the complaint.

200.description: The attendance record with the complaint resolved.

400.description: The id is not a UUID, the body is invalid, or the record has no complaint.

403.description: The caller has no user profile, or the role may not resolve complaints.

404.description: The attendance record does not exist.
